Folks — I reviewed QuantPath's requests and the annotated SOW. High-level legal position and required approvals:  

1) BYOK: we can accept a BYOK flow but cannot contractually state Redwood "will not retain" any derivative keys or seals; proposed redline: "Customer-provided keys used for tenant encryption; Redwood will not export or use private key material for other tenants or services. Key management access will be auditable."
2) Audit window: acceptable as a timeboxed tenant-scoped evidence package. We must:
   - Define the trigger event and a maximum number of requests per contract year.
   - Require QuantPath to sign an evidence-handling NDA and accept cost-recovery for forensics time beyond a baseline (we propose $X/hour).
3) Indemnity/limit of liability: QuantPath requests a narrower indemnity for pilot activities. Legal suggests a capped carveout for breaches caused by QuantPath misconfiguration and a standard mutual indemnity otherwise.

BOTTOM LINE: This set of redlines is outside the standard SOW and requires one of the following for approval:
- Executive commercial waiver (VP Sales or CRO) to accept the proposed credit schedule and the BYOK language; AND
- Legal director signoff on the indemnity carveout and the forensics cost-recovery language.

I have attached a redlined SOW (inline comments in the PDF) and a suggested replacement clause for BYOK and audit. Marcus Lin — please confirm technical feasibility of the BYOK binding and that the forensics package we propose can be produced within a 48-hour window without host-level access.

Markus Klein
